data.status: certificate of occupancy under review
data.short_description: Ginger's Bread & Co. has filed a change of tenant application to use an existing baking kitchen at 62 S Cooper Street. The 2,000-square-foot space will function as both a restaurant and bakery. The certificate of occupancy is under review as of July 17.

data.status: coming to Virginia
data.short_description: Din Tai Fung is opening its first regional location at Tysons Corner Center as part of a $100 million redevelopment. The Michelin-starred restaurant will be accessible from the new Metro plaza. No opening timeline is available.

data.status: signed a lease
data.short_description: Hawkers Asian Street Fare has signed a lease for the 5,228-square-foot space formerly occupied by Ted's Montana Grill. It will be the concept's second Montgomery County location. No timeline has been provided.

data.status: opening next month
data.short_description: Gussied Up, from the team behind Hard Times Deli, will share space with Hard Times and open in August. It will operate Wednesday through Sunday with a menu of reimagined comfort food. An exact opening date is not yet available.

data.location: 1227 S Germantown Road, Suite 101, Germantown, TN 38139
data.status: filed papers / plans submitted
data.short_description: Ramblin' Joe's has filed plans for exterior improvements at the former Simmons Bank site, including a patio, bike rack, and drive-thru. The location would span 3,000 square feet with 19 indoor seats. No opening timeline is available.

data.status: interior renovation planned
data.short_description: The EVthing is investing $270,000 in a 2,500-square-foot interior remodel of its downtown Cuero location. Construction is expected to begin May 2026 and conclude by December 2026. An official reopening timeline has not been announced.

data.status: set to open
data.short_description: Wonder food hall is taking over the former Noodles & Company location in Sully Plaza. A spokesperson confirmed it will open in spring 2027. Wonder partners with high-profile chefs to offer multiple concepts under one roof.

data.status: construction is already underway / targeted opening in late September or early October
data.short_description: Tacos Frontera's first official franchise, owned by Alfred Clemesha, is set to open in Pasadena. It will be the brand's fourth location overall. Construction is underway with a targeted opening in late September or early October.

data.status: listed among upcoming restaurants
data.short_description: EggBred is expanding to Brentwood at 6740 Lone Tree Way, adding to its Northern California footprint. The concept focuses on egg sandwiches, breakfast burritos, and morning fare. Construction progress and an official grand opening date have not been announced.

data.status: relocating operations
data.short_description: The Kitchen Sink GF, a gluten-free bakery, is relocating operations to San Francisco per an Instagram announcement. No specific address or opening timeline has been disclosed. Additional details have not been announced.

data.short_description: Coco Bloom Coffee is opening a new café in Newport Beach and is currently working through permitting. Founder Chloe Wilhite is targeting an opening in early 2027. The brand offers specialty coffee, matcha, teas, and light café fare.

data.status: plans confirmed
data.short_description: The Taco Stand is expanding to Irvine with a new location at 7300 Great Park Blvd. It will serve the Great Park Neighborhoods with Tijuana-style street food. An official opening timeline has not been announced.

data.location: 2800 N Main Place Drive, Santa Ana, CA 92868
data.status: plan review filed
data.short_description: Pepper Lunch appears to be planning a new Orange County location inside MainPlace Mall based on a recently filed plan review. The company has not publicly announced the project. The concept serves meals on patented iron plates heated to high temperatures.

data.status: officially headed to Brea Mall / will anchor late summer 2026 exterior redevelopment
data.short_description: Din Tai Fung is joining Brea Mall as part of a multimillion-dollar redevelopment. It will anchor the mall's late summer 2026 exterior redevelopment alongside Kalbi Social Club. Additional new concepts are also planned for the property.

data.location: 4972 S Maryland Pkwy, Ste 3-4, Las Vegas, NV 89119
data.status: set to open / plan is to open this summer
data.short_description: Lalibela Ethiopian Restaurant and Bar is planning a location in the Camelot Shopping Center near UNLV. Owner Tsehau Retta confirmed plans to open this summer. Further details were unavailable at publication.

data.status: permanently closed
data.short_description: A Lalibela Ethiopian Restaurant at 870 Sierra Vista Dr was a long-standing fixture in Las Vegas and is now permanently closed. It is unclear if this location is related to the upcoming Camelot Shopping Center opening.

data.status: set to debut / grand opening this summer
data.short_description: Pour Decisions Craft Coffee + Beer will debut its first Texas location in The Heights at 555 W 19th St alongside the Foundry on 19th. Founded in San Jose in 2023, it would be the brand's fourth location. The concept combines Vietnamese phin-drip coffee with a California craft beer taproom.

data.location: 8300 Hayden Road, Suite D-101, Scottsdale, AZ 85258
data.status: expected to open
data.short_description: Vecina is expanding to Scottsdale, opening its second location in late August at the former Z'Tejas space in McCormick Ranch. The larger space will allow expansion beyond dinner-only service to include lunch, brunch, and happy hour. The restaurant will feature a lakeside patio and design elements from the original.

data.status: under construction; coming soon
data.short_description: Ididos Coffee & Social, an Arlington-based cafe, has begun construction on a new DC storefront at 1601 Rhode Island Ave NE. The announcement was shared on the brand's official Instagram.

data.status: set to open; construction to wrap by late August
data.short_description: Einstein Bros. Bagels plans to open inside Texas A&M's Law & Education Building in Fort Worth, with construction wrapping by late August. Tenant is listed as Gideon Toal Management Services, whose portfolio includes QDOBA, Firehouse Subs, and Fatburger.

data.status: expected to open in mid-to-late August
data.short_description: Coffee TAB, a nonprofit specialty coffee shop and barista apprenticeship program, is opening its third Seattle cafe in the former Starbucks at 2300 S. Jackson St. in the Central District. Founder Johnathan Tran said the location will expand its paid apprenticeship program.

data.status: looking at November or December
data.short_description: Tropical Smoothie Cafe is opening at 13403 US-1 in Sebastian, targeting November or December. It is the first location for franchisee Katrina Strand, transitioning from 31 years in the Department of Defense.

data.status: hopes to welcome guests before the end of 2026
data.short_description: Hinata Shokudo is a new Japanese teishoku concept from chef Moe Kuroki, formerly of Oisa Ramen, planned for Jamaica Plain with an exact address not yet announced. Kuroki plans about 17 seats and to apply for a beer and wine license to serve sake.

data.status: preparing to open by the end of August
data.short_description: Soju Station is a Korean pocha concept from restaurateur Jaong Woo opening at 1976 W. Southern Ave. in Mesa. Woo's portfolio also includes BanChan, Babo Jumak, Kimchi Korean BBQ, and Kimchi Xpress.

data.status: opening in "Late 2026"
data.short_description: Bad Ass Coffee of Hawaii is opening a new Daytona Beach location at 821 E International Speedway Blvd in Late 2026. The chain, founded in 1989 on the Big Island of Hawaii, is expanding across Florida.

data.status: Temporarily closed
data.short_description: Kurosumi Kitchen, a Japanese smoked-food restaurant, has vacated its former location at 1504 Max Hooks Rd, Suite I, in Groveland, marked "Temporarily closed" on Google Maps. It is reopening at a new Groveland address as a sit-down concept.

data.status: still under construction; hoping to be open within 4-5 weeks
data.short_description: Kurosumi Kitchen is reopening at 135 E Broad St, Suite E, in Groveland, transitioning from takeout to a sit-down concept with a soft opening planned. Executive Chef and COO Dustin Campbell will run day-to-day operations with Nicole Isenhour.

data.status: currently going through the permitting process
data.short_description: Sissy Dogs is a new mobile hot dog and sausage food truck preparing to launch in Jacksonville, currently in permitting. Possible home locations include the BP on Commonwealth Avenue and the Home Depot on Lane Avenue.

data.status: entering into the permitting phase; breaking ground in the next few months
data.short_description: Bushrangers Brewery is a new microbrewery from The Kookaburra Coffee opening at its St. Augustine roastery and headquarters at 470 State Road 207, after receiving unanimous zoning approval. It will brew beer, cider, and possibly mead alongside a full kitchen.

data.status: opening is targeted for late November or December
data.short_description: ICONYC Bagels is a New York-style bagel shop opening at 202 W. Cesar Chavez St. across from Lady Bird Lake in downtown Austin. The ownership group ICONYC Foods brought in third-generation bagel maker Robert Goldberg to guide the recipes.

data.status: coming soon
data.short_description: Bondi Sushi is opening its sixth location at the Shops at Merrick Park, 358 San Lorenzo Avenue in Coral Gables. Founded by Adam Carty and Jason Hess, the brand also operates in Brickell, Midtown Miami, Miami Beach, Fort Lauderdale, and New York's Bryant Park.

data.status: preparing to open this fall
data.short_description: Quail House Coffee & Creamery is a new cafe opening this fall at Desert Botanical Garden, serving coffee, tea, gelato, and grab-and-go bites. It is operated in partnership with chef Mark Tarbell of Gertrude's and Patio Cafe.

data.status: planned
data.short_description: Keke's Breakfast Cafe, powered by Denny's, has a new location planned at 725 Skymarks Drive in Jacksonville by franchisee RREMC Restaurants. RREMC owns more than 80 Denny's locations plus multiple Keke's cafes.

data.status: recently opened
data.short_description: A new Keke's Breakfast Cafe opened in Mandarin on June 2, operated by franchisee RREMC Restaurants. RREMC also plans two more Northeast Florida Keke's locations in 2027 and 2028.

data.status: plan review documents submitted
data.short_description: Tuxedos Pizza and Chilly Cups is a new pizza food truck from B.K. Trucking Enterprise, L.L.C., with plan review paperwork placing it at St. Augustine Commissary at 233 W King St., Suite A. The owner also runs B.K. Executive Party Bus and Lounge.

data.status: looking like the first week of August for opening
data.short_description: Whit's Frozen Custard, founded in 2003 in Granville, Ohio, is opening a new location at 5147 Ocean Blvd on Siesta Key. It is the first of several planned locations from the Fineberg family.

data.status: construction is expected to begin in September 2026 and conclude by November 2026
data.short_description: Little Caesars is planning a new 1,200-square-foot restaurant at 2286 Alyssa Way, Suite 105, in New Braunfels, per Texas Department of Licensing and Regulation filings. The estimated project cost is $250,000, with Rene Jackson listed as tenant.

data.status: plan review paperwork submitted
data.short_description: La Michoacana, a Haines City-based Mexican ice cream chain, has submitted plan review paperwork for a new location at 198 Melton Ave in Auburndale. The site is near Wawa, Salem's Fresh Eats, Taco Bell, and Domino's Pizza.

data.status: opening soon
data.short_description: Pepe's Cantina is opening its eighth full-service location at 3011 W. Yamato Road in Boca Raton, at the former Lucille's space, marking its first Palm Beach County location. Founded in 2015 by Frank Chavez, the chain has begun hiring for the new site.

data.status: preparing to expand
data.short_description: Sana'a Café is opening a new Orange County location at 12212 Brookhurst Street in Garden Grove, confirmed by founder Sadeq Alaqel. The Middle Eastern-inspired cafe already has locations in Los Angeles.

data.status: set to open later this summer
data.short_description: Cay Bar & Grill is a new Vietnamese restaurant and bar from Khoa Tran taking over the former McCormick & Schmick's Harborside space in RiverPlace. An August or September opening is being targeted.

data.status: construction expected to begin in May 2026 and wrap up by October 2026
data.short_description: Domino's Pizza is planning a new 2,125-square-foot restaurant in Yoakum with a $200,000 interior build-out per Texas Department of Licensing and Regulation filings. Tenant is Tim McBride; property owned by LOBO Street LLC.

data.status: An official opening date has not yet been announced
data.short_description: Hijau is an Indonesian-inspired specialty coffee concept from Lisa Maria and Ryan Prawiradjaja opening its first permanent café in San Jose. It began as the South Bay's first Indonesian specialty coffee pop-up in 2024.

data.address: The Switchyard, NE corner of Ellsworth Loop Road and Ocotillo Road
data.status: An opening date has not yet been announced
data.short_description: Salt & Straw, the Portland-founded ice cream brand, is planning its fourth Arizona shop at The Switchyard mixed-use development in Queen Creek. It will join tenants including Postino, Shake Shack, Snooze, and Bamboo Sushi.

data.status: officially bringing "Diner 2.0" concept to 1674 Broadway
data.short_description: Diner 24, the "Diner 2.0" concept from Stratis Morfogen and Philippe Olivier Bondon (Brooklyn Chop House, Brooklyn Dumpling Shop), is opening a two-story Theater District flagship at 1674 Broadway. It follows the success of the Gramercy location.

data.status: renovations are underway; may be sometime next month
data.short_description: Don Patron is a Mexican restaurant opening its second location inside Great Lakes Crossing Outlets in Auburn Hills. The first location is in Sterling Heights; co-owner Gustavo Torres did not confirm a firm opening date.

data.status: An opening date has not been announced
data.short_description: PopUp Bagels, the "Grip, Rip & Dip" bagel brand founded in 2020 in Westport, CT, is planning a new Brickell location. It now operates about 40 locations nationwide, including eight in Florida.

data.status: An opening timeline has not yet been announced
data.short_description: Elevate Coffee, founded by Chloey and Ryan Wilson, secured a commercial building permit for a downtown Nashville café interior build-out. It expands the brand from its Hermitage flagship and locations in Donelson and Lebanon.

data.status: recently filed permit; opening timeline pending
data.short_description: Muse Paintbar is bringing its paint-and-sip experience to Inman Park in a 3,084-square-foot space with paint studios, kitchen, and bar area. It will be the brand's second Atlanta location, joining The Battery spot.

data.status: set to become Harry Hare's; liquor license transfer approved
data.short_description: Harry Hare's is a new English-inspired fine-dining restaurant with Indian influences from veteran restaurateur Patrick Lyons, taking over the former Beacon Hill Pub space. The Boston Licensing Board approved the liquor license transfer.

data.status: ownership change, not an opening/closing/remodel
data.short_description: Crystola Roadhouse, the historic mountain venue near Woodland Park, is under new ownership by Holly, Shelton, and Steven Ellis, introducing Southern-inspired dishes and entertainment. This is an ownership transfer rather than an opening/closing event.

data.status: will open at 1601 Walnut St. this fall
data.short_description: Somedays Bakery, founded by Peter Phillips and known for hand-laminated croissants, is opening its first Philadelphia location as a franchise operated by Dino Porfyris. The brand currently operates five locations across NY and NJ.

data.status: expected to open with the luxury hotel in late 2027
data.short_description: Ten Five Hospitality will debut three original F&B concepts — a signature ground-floor restaurant, all-day café/lobby bar, and rooftop garden restaurant — at Pendry Nashville in Paseo South Gulch. The hotel will feature 180 rooms and 146 branded residences by SomeraRoad and TrestleStudio.

data.status: on track to open in October
data.short_description: Britt's Donut Shop, the family-owned Carolina Beach donut shop founded in 1939, is opening its first Charleston location this fall. Owner Melinda Nivens Prusa announced the expansion on Instagram.

data.status: signed agreements to open this fall
data.short_description: Slutty Vegan, the plant-based burger chain founded by Aisha "Pinky" Cole Hayes in Atlanta in 2018, is entering Ohio with Columbus as one of its first markets. Expansion is being led by Ohio-based Soul Republic Hospitality Group.

data.status: signed agreements to open this fall
data.short_description: Slutty Vegan, the plant-based burger chain founded by Aisha "Pinky" Cole Hayes, is opening a Cleveland location as part of its Ohio debut. Expansion is led by Soul Republic Hospitality Group.

data.status: will permanently close; last dinner on August 1
data.short_description: Osteria, a family-owned Italian restaurant known for scallops, meatballs, and fettuccine Alfredo, is permanently closing after 21 years. Owner Roberto cited retirement in the announcement.

data.status: lease was signed; space recently acquired
data.short_description: Humble Kitchen is a new 1,200-square-foot ice cream and coffee shop from local Tiffany White in the Wayneport shopping center. It will share the building with China Chef and Romulus Beauty Supply, in space formerly occupied by Lizzy Lit Hookah.

data.status: targeting a March 2027 opening
data.short_description: Penn Station Sandwiches is bringing East Coast-style subs to Myrtle Beach with two new locations led by franchisee Eric Fairbanks in partnership with Sait Perez. This is the first of two planned locations in the market.

data.status: will debut Gwynne on July 28
data.short_description: Gwynne is a chef-driven American restaurant from Executive Chef Brad Bernstein opening inside the Fidelity Hotel in the historic Gwynne Building. It will serve breakfast, lunch, dinner, and weekend brunch daily.

data.status: expected to open later in Fall 2026
data.short_description: Bottega Volo is opening a second Toronto location as an Italian café, bottle shop, and specialty food retailer in Junction Triangle, moving into space behind the recently closed Pizzeria Defina. It will also serve as headquarters for the Keep6 Imports business.

data.status: opening
data.short_description: Sprout & Bean is a play café combining an artisan coffee shop with an indoor playground at 965 Vineland Road in Winter Garden, Florida. It features locally roasted Prairie House coffee, buttermilk bakery goods, and a play area with a tiny village, climbing structures, carousel, and ball pit.

data.status: set to join The Jesse mixed-use development
data.short_description: 51st Deli, founded by Carim Yafai in 2018, is opening a new East Nashville location at 730 Main Street inside The Jesse, a mixed-use development by Richland Building Partners. The menu features breakfast/lunch sandwiches, tacos, a salad bar, fresh juices, and catering; an opening timeline has not been announced.

data.status: grand opening will take place on July 31 at 7 pm
data.short_description: Station Casinos is opening a new 24-hour Seventy Six Taverns at 976 W. Dorrell Ln. in North Las Vegas, with a ribbon-cutting on July 30 and public grand opening July 31. The Americana-style neighborhood tavern offers comfort food, handcrafted cocktails, 15 bartop gaming machines, and multiple TVs.

data.status: final day of service set for July 31
data.short_description: The Basement Lounge, a cocktail bar open since 2015 at 6323 Camp Bowie Blvd #125 in Fort Worth, is closing on July 31 due to rising rent, insurance, and other operating costs. Owners Jesse Meráz and Christopher Neu announced the closure on Instagram and hope to bring a new concept to Fort Worth someday.
